answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarization has received constant research attention... We manually evaluate 10 text summarizers... using PolyTope.

answer_2.quote: ROUGE has been adopted by most work on summarization... We also compute the Pearson correlation coefficients between ROUGE-P and PolyTope.

answer_4.quote: Three candidates with a linguistic background and high level of English proficiency are employed for manual evaluation... annotators are presented the original text and an output summary... they select segments deemed incorrect and label them with issue types and syntactic labels.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators select incorrect segments and assign one of 8 issue types (Addition, Omission, Inaccuracy Intrinsic, Inaccuracy Extrinsic, Positive-Negative Aspect, Duplication, Word Order, Word Form) and one of 8 syntactic labels according to the PolyTope framework.
